name: Joseph Dulin-Didonato
statement:
To Whom It May Concern,
For six years, I've built an extensive portfolio of large scale murals, projects, gallery pieces, and commissions consistently delivering quality work on time. This piece should offer an exciting experience while showcasing images from Czech/ Bohemian  history. The design could reflect everything from wildlife and natural features collaging with traditional patterns and clothing, my idea would center on traditional Czech themes. More specifically would be a woman enjoying a moment dancing or entertaining in her traditional folk clothing from, either, the Bohemian or Mid Moravia regions.  But, The piece should most importantly have a balance in composition so the mural is more like a large scale painting, elegant and easily understood.
In 2024, I completed a large scale mural in Cleveland, OH, for Woodhill Homes. The design was intended to reflect the community's past and future while highlighting its members. Site management facilitated meetings with residents to gather their input. A main goal was to include community members. One resident was selected to act as my assistant on part of this project. On the final day, we invited residents' children to add their own paint to the mural, creating a work that represents community history and strengthens neighborhood bonds.
Having led all aspects of this project, and more like it, I believe I have proven ability in managing time, materials, and design quality. I have also collaborated with other accomplished artists on large scale projects. Whether working within a team or corresponding with site management, I can direct and complete any project. For example, in 2022 I was involved in the Sullivant Bright project, painting a mural on a 120 foot long and over 30 foot tall highway underpass, involving many other artists and city officials. My resume includes numerous murals, accolades, and references that I believe qualify me for this project.
To build community connection, I would have no problem attending community meetings and resident outreach to listen to their stories, creating a design rooted in history from the surrounding area. Additionally, we can pool a small group of residents to learn and safely paint directly to the mural, on the ground level of the wall, just as I have done in the past in other public projects. To draw more attention, I could create a series of social media videos expanding on this project and documenting the mural from design to paint and anything in between. It is my intention to make this a fun and exciting project while maintaining a professional experience.
Sincerely,
Joseph Dulin - Didonato
